name: Reinhard CFG (megapack, tonemapped guidance in one node)
plain: One node that does what core gets from chaining its Reinhard tonemap operation into Latent Apply Operation CFG. It takes the guidance difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, measures its size per pixel across channels, and squashes large sizes smoothly with the Reinhard curve m/(m+1) against a ceiling set per image from the mean plus five standard deviations. Directions are kept; only lengths shrink. A large multiplier raises the ceiling, so it behaves more and more like plain CFG.
math:
Symbols: x̂_c, x̂_u conditional and unconditional x0 predictions; w guidance scale; g = x̂_c − x̂_u; m = ‖g‖ over channels per pixel (+1e-10).
top = multiplier · (mean(m) + 5·std(m)) per image; m' = top · (m/top) / (m/top + 1).
Output: x̂ = x̂_u + w · g · m'/m.

props.params: multiplier (default 1.0); scale -1 uses the guider's CFG
